Featured projects

Work built to be measured, not just shown.

Data Analytics · Power BI

Porsche 911 Analytics Dashboard

An interactive Power BI dashboard exploring performance and engineering specs across Porsche 911 generations: 50 models and 60+ technical attributes, cleaned in Power Query. Shows top speed rising from 288 to 323 km/h, the fastest 0-100 km/h time of 3.1 s, and how power per litre relates to top speed, with an interactive generation filter.

Power BIPower QueryDAXCanva

Computer Vision · Fuzzy Logic

Focus-Metric

A system combining computer vision and fuzzy logic to quantify classroom engagement in real time. A fuzzy inference layer translates visual engagement cues into interpretable engagement scores.

PythonComputer VisionFuzzy Logic
Machine Learning · Team project

End-to-End Stroke Prediction System

Complete ML pipeline on the Healthcare Stroke Dataset: EDA, data cleaning, class imbalance handled with SMOTE, AUC-ROC evaluation, and a deployed Streamlit app. Missing BMI values and the "Unknown" smoking status were handled to improve data quality.

PythonSMOTEAUC-ROCStreamlit
